title: Vanishing of degree $3$ unramified cohomology over finite fields
summary: Let $k$ be a finite field of characteristic $p\neq 3$, let $E/k$ be the Fermat cubic curve, and let $\ell\neq p$ be a prime. If $p\equiv1\pmod3$, assume moreover that $\ell>3$. Then $H^3_{\mathrm{nr}}(k(E^3)/k,\mathbb{Q}_\ell/\mathbb{Z}_\ell(2))=0$ and the cycle map \[CH^2(E^3)_{\mathbb{Z}_\ell}\longrightarrow H^4(E^3,\mathbb{Z}_\ell(2))\] is surjective. In particular, $H^3_{\mathrm{nr}}(\overline{k}(E^3)/\overline{k},\mathbb{Q}_\ell/\mathbb{Z}_\ell(2))=0$.
